q: Transparent media such as air, water, oil and glass have different ____.
e: Transparent media such as air, water, oil and glass have different optical densities. Optical densities is what this statement is using.

q: When light passes through two media of different optical densities, the ____ of light changes in passing from the first to the second medium.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. When light passes through two media of different optical densities, the direction of light changes in passing from the first to the second medium.

q: This phenomenon is called ____ of light.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. This phenomenon is called refraction of light.

q: When light passes from one medium to another, the ____ of light changes in both magnitude and direction.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. When light passes from one medium to another, the velocity of light changes in both magnitude and direction. Velocity is the term used with When light passes from one medium.

q: The more optically dense a medium is, the ____ is the velocity of light in that medium.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. The more optically dense a medium is, the smaller is the velocity of light in that medium.

q: Since the second medium is optically more dense, the refracted ray bends ____ the normal.
e: Since the second medium is optically more dense, the refracted ray bends towards the normal. Towards is what this statement is using.

q: When the medium is optically less dense, the refracted ray bends ____ from the normal.
e: When the medium is optically less dense, the refracted ray bends away from the normal. Away is what this statement is using.

q: The angle between the incident ray and the normal is called the angle of incidence and is represented by ____.
e: The angle between the incident ray and the normal is called the angle of incidence and is represented by i. The name used here is i.
